note: error.code is the stable machine interface; exitCode is the CLI's coarse class (CLI plan v1.2 §06). Codes marked reserved are named now so every client maps them the same way; no PR1 method returns them.

codes.description: Command line or parameters refused before anything was sent.
Request is not valid JSON of this API, or fails its schema.
A message exceeded maxFrameBytes (LF included).
The ID in the request names nothing this Runtime knows.
The action's target does not resolve inside the bound window of its snapshot; nothing was sent.
No Runtime accepted the connection; nothing was sent.
Endpoint or caller is not the current user's, or an OS permission is missing.
A client asked for platform ownership or a durable lifetime; refused (ADR v2.2).
The operation waits for a person.
Another controller holds the Desktop.
The snapshot no longer matches the target.
Same requestId, different content.
State does not allow the operation (e.g. destroy with active writes).
The Run was cancelled or ended; it takes no new input.
Input is stopped for all Runs (runtime.stopAll); an owner must enable it again.
Runs are still stopping; the operation waits for quiescence.
A connection sent a method before runtime.handshake.
No API version in common, or the request names another apiVersion.
The endpoint answered, but not as the AgentDesktop Runtime.
Method or option is not implemented by this Runtime/backend.
The operation needs a model that is not configured.
A known failure of a unit or task; side effects may exist.
The Runtime failed while handling a read-only request.
A configured limit (steps, time, budget, quota) refused or ended the work.
The events cursor points before the retained range; read the current state with run.show.
A local wait ended before the wanted state; the server state is unchanged.
The request's deadline passed before dispatch; nothing was sent.
The client is not paired; pair it in AgentDesktop before calling this method.

The client was removed; its credential no longer works. On a write the service already did, details.writeOutcome is "completed", notSent is false and details.recovery is "check_outcome_do_not_resubmit": pairing again gives a new client id that cannot look the request up, so check the outcome and do not submit it again.

The capability, Desktop or app is not in the client's grant. On a write the service already did, details.writeOutcome is "completed", notSent is false and details.recovery is "look_up_same_request_id": only the answer is withheld.

The grant that covered this has expired. On a write the service already did, details.writeOutcome is "completed", notSent is false and details.recovery is "look_up_same_request_id": only the answer is withheld.
The approval permit expired, was used, or belongs to an older generation.
At dispatch the target's geometry or binding generation no longer matched the observation; nothing was sent.
Evidence could not be recorded; input is paused until it can be.

The backend cannot do this action in the background without side effects (act kind drag on macOS: background_drag_unsupported; act kind hover on macOS, which would be a middle click: background_hover_activates); it is not done another way instead. notSent: true, details.reason says which.
The GUI profile and the fallback model speak different action protocols.
Connected and sent, but no complete response arrived.
A write may or may not have been accepted.
Input may or may not have been delivered.
A cancel may or may not have been accepted.
